sources.title: LFM2.5-2.6B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B is Liquid AI's 2.6B dense model built for agentic workloads with a 131K context window and native tool calling. It is a reasoning model that always thinks before it answers. It runs on edge devices and it is trained to work reliably inside agent harnesses like Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Pi.
